issues.where: the whole frame in the last two seconds, the skeleton seen from orbit
issues.what: nothing changes across 120 frames: the bone shapes, the orange point in the ribs, the swirl at lower right and the planet's edge sit frozen, so the ending reads as a still picture rather than a living world seen from height
issues.fix: keep the climb or a slow drift going to the last frame, let cloud move over the surface and the glow breathe unevenly, and settle on a strong composition instead of a dead hold

issues.where: the ground under the camera at orbital height
issues.what: the surface reads as a glowing line drawing of a skeleton on black, not a real view from that height. There is no atmosphere layer, cloud, terminator light or surface tone
issues.fix: render the land and sea with real albedo, cloud cover and an atmospheric rim so the giant form reads as terrain seen from orbit

issues.where: the pale four-legged animal on the cliff face at left, and the small creatures along the far shore
issues.what: held in the same pose for all 480 frames of the loop. There is no weight shift, head turn or step, so they read as placed models in a living scene
issues.fix: give the cliff animal a few non-repeating idle actions (head turn, weight shift, a step on the ledge) and stagger small motions in the shore creatures so they are never in step

issues.where: the shallow water and wet flats in the foreground
issues.what: apart from one foam edge creeping in near the end, the water surface changes very little across eight seconds and reads more like a texture than water with weight. It shows no clear wash and draw-back of a thin sheet over the flats
issues.fix: add a slow wash that runs up, thins and drains back with foam breaking at its edge, and let ripples and reflections move with it

issues.where: the foam edge at the lower centre across the seam from loop 479 to loop 0
issues.what: the foam line at the end of the loop is slightly brighter and further forward than at the start, so a careful viewer could find the seam
issues.fix: match foam position and brightness over the last and first frames, or cross-blend the water simulation over the final half-second

issues.where: the birds over the sea in the first seconds
issues.what: the near birds hold nearly the same wing pose from frame to frame and glide on straight paths, close to a cycled sprite
issues.fix: vary wingbeat phase and timing per bird and add banking and changes of speed
